howToPlay: Carl throws his pickaxe like a boomerang, so focus on positioning to ensure it hits targets on both the way out and the return. Utilize Flying Hook for mobility or Heat Ejector to zone enemies with damage. Use the Super to deal rapid damage, and combine it with Protective Pirouette to stay alive during the rotation.
gears: Equip DAMAGE for increased power when low on health, SHIELD to boost survivability, or SPEED to navigate the map faster. GADGET COOLDOWN is excellent for using Heat Ejector or Flying Hook more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits a strategic player who enjoys managing boomerang mechanics and tactical movement.
